capabilities: Classify notes by tags or folders
Track due, overdue, and recurring tasks
Schedule spaced reviews with fixed intervals
Read notes aloud with selectable TTS engines
disambiguation: Not a general PKM suite; it is a dashboard for tag classification, task follow-ups, spaced review, and read-aloud.
extras: README is in Chinese. Read-aloud is the only network feature; reminders require importing the generated .ics into a system calendar because the plugin does not run in the background. Custom TTS gateways require the user's own API key.
problem: Obsidian lacks a single local dashboard for overdue tasks, spaced reviews, tag-based classification, and read-aloud.
